title: Pullback cube for the intrinsic semilinear alpha transformation
statement:
Let $C_1\leftarrow C_2\leftarrow\cdots$ be arbitrary commutative rings. On the small pro-etale sites of schemes use the strict semilinear operations of [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] and the open-unit-normalized $\beta$ and clopen-projection $\alpha$ of [def-sp-varying-ring-proper-open-arrows]. In this node write $P_v=D(v^*_{\bullet})$ for exact derived inverse image and $J_j=D(j_{!,\bullet})$ for open extension. Let $Q$ be $pk=ir$ with $k:U\hookrightarrow V$, $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ quasi-compact open and $p:V\to Z$, $r:U\to W$ proper. Let $h:Z_1\to Z$, and base change all four vertices, writing $a:V_1\to V$, $c:W_1\to W$, $d:U_1\to U$ and $Q_1=(k_1,i_1,r_1,p_1)$ for the projections and induced square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then the following two transformations from $P_{p_1}P_hJ_i$ to $J_{k_1}P_{r_1}P_c$ agree:
$$P_{p_1}P_hJ_i\xrightarrow{P_{p_1}\beta_{i,h}}P_{p_1}J_{i_1}P_c\xrightarrow{\alpha_{Q_1}P_c}J_{k_1}P_{r_1}P_c,$$
$$P_{p_1}P_hJ_i\cong P_aP_pJ_i\xrightarrow{P_a\alpha_Q}P_aJ_kP_r\xrightarrow{\beta_{k,a}P_r}J_{k_1}P_dP_r\cong J_{k_1}P_{r_1}P_c.$$
Use the specified pullback and open compositors. This is already an equality after exact localization of ordinary system transformations, before taking any proper direct-image mate.

proof.text: Work on ordinary semilinear systems. For the changed proper/open square put T1=V1 ×_Z1 W1, b1=pr1, q1=pr2 and s1=(k1,r1). The lift s1 is clopen. The two cartesian open beta comparisons identify the common source with b1! q1* c* M.

Equality is detected after k1-star. Indeed use extension b1 ⊣ pull b1 and the source identification to reduce to equality after b1-star. The target restricted along b1 is s1! r1* c* M, using the unit of b1 and the specified open compositor. Its canonical clopen comparison identifies it with s1_* r1* c* M. The adjunction s1-star ⊣ s1_* then detects equality after s1-star. The pullback compositor identifies the composite test with k1-star. These are two injective adjunction Hom equivalences; no detection from derived evaluations is used.

Take the defining open-unit transpose of inverse beta. The adjunction apply-symm identity gives u_jprime followed by jprime-star beta-inverse equal to a-star u_j followed by inverse square comparison. Invert this equality of isomorphisms to obtain the restriction formula for beta.

Use lem-sf-semilinear-alpha-restriction on the two proper/open faces. After postcomposing both tested paths by the inverse unit of k1, naturality of the square comparisons and of the inverse open unit, together with step 3, reduces the desired equality to the inverse-image compositor cube followed by r1-star c-star of the inverse unit of i.
Apply lem-sf-semilinear-pullback-cube-coherence to the six face equalities. This proves the reduced ordinary equality, so the two Hom equivalences of step 2 prove moduleAlpha_baseChange.

Interpret the twelve exact ordinary functors as edges of a finite word diagram and the six ordinary natural transformations as cells. Build the two cube paths with input and output whiskering and structural associators. Their ordinary interpretations agree by moduleAlpha_baseChange. Apply exact-derived-transformation pasting to obtain equality of their derived interpretations. The two-edge cell formula is precisely inverse source composition comparison, localized degreewise transformation, and forward target composition comparison. Thus the resulting cells are exactly alpha, alphaPullbackBeta and alphaPullbackSquareG (or its inverse), proving alpha_baseChange on all unbounded derived objects.
